query: What is the policy on international travel?
answer:
Summary of TechCorp Solutions — International Travel Policy
- Eligibility and purpose
  - Company supports business travel for approved company purposes.
- Approvals and timing
  - All international travel must be pre-approved by the employee's direct manager and the HR department at least 10 business days in advance.
- Documentation required
  - Employees must submit a detailed itinerary including destination, purpose of travel, hotel accommodation, and estimated expenses.
- Airfare
  - Economy-class airfare covered for flights under 8 hours.
  - Business-class airfare covered for flights exceeding 8 hours.
- Hotel reimbursement
  - Up to $250 USD per night in standard cities.
  - Up to $400 USD per night in high-cost cities (e.g. New York, London, Tokyo, Singapore).
- Meals and expenses
  - Meals reimbursed at a flat daily rate of $80 USD.
  - Employees must retain all receipts and submit expense reports within 10 business days of returning.
- Insurance and payment
  - Travel insurance is provided automatically for all approved international trips.
  - Employees must carry their corporate travel card for all travel-related expenses.
- Related environmental guidance
  - The company encourages choosing ground transportation over air travel for distances under 500 km when feasible.

query: What are the remote work options available?
answer:
TechCorp Solutions' remote work options and key requirements
- Model: Hybrid work model — full-time employees may work remotely.
- Standard remote allowance: Up to 3 remote days per week after completing the 90-day onboarding period.
- Full-remote option: Full-remote (5 days/week) may be approved on a case-by-case basis for senior employees with demonstrated performance.
- Approval & documentation: Remote arrangements must be agreed with the employee's manager and documented in the HR system.
- Availability: Remote employees must be available during core business hours, 9:00 AM–3:00 PM local time.
- Technical & environment requirements: Must maintain a stable internet connection and a professional, distraction-free work environment.
- Stipend: One-time home office stipend of $500 USD for eligible remote workers to cover equipment (monitors, keyboards, ergonomic accessories).

query: What products does the company offer?
answer:
TechCorp Solutions offers a suite of enterprise software products:
- TechCore ERP
  - Comprehensive enterprise resource planning platform for mid-to-large organizations.
  - Covers financial management, supply chain, human resources, and procurement in a single integrated system.
  - Pricing: starts at $5,000 per month for up to 100 users.
- DataSight Analytics
  - Business intelligence and analytics platform with real-time dashboards, predictive analytics, and AI-driven insights.
  - Integrates with over 200 data sources; available cloud-hosted or on-premise.
  - Pricing: starts at $2,000 per month.
- SecureID
  - Identity and access management solution providing single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, and role-based access control.
  - Certified SOC2 Type II and ISO 27001.
  - Pricing: starts at $8 per user per month (minimum 50 users).
- FlowDesk
  - Customer support and helpdesk platform with AI-powered ticket routing, SLA management, and a self-service knowledge base portal.
  - Supports integrations with Slack, Microsoft Teams, Salesforce, and Jira.
  - Pricing: starts at $25 per agent per month.
